socfpga_noc_firewall.h

NoC Firewall hardware abstraction driver interface for the SoCFPGA bare-metal software stack.

Types
socfpga_noc_firewall_target_t

Identifies the specific hardware peripheral or interconnect bridge protected by the NoC Firewall. These targets correspond to individual security policy registers within the L4 interconnect that dictate whether a peripheral can be accessed by Non-Secure bus masters.

Values
SOCFPGA_NOC_FW_I2C0

Firewall target for I2C instance 0.

SOCFPGA_NOC_FW_I2C1

Firewall target for I2C instance 1.

SOCFPGA_NOC_FW_I2C2

Firewall target for I2C instance 2.

SOCFPGA_NOC_FW_I2C3

Firewall target for I2C instance 3.

SOCFPGA_NOC_FW_I2C4

Firewall target for I2C instance 4.

SOCFPGA_NOC_FW_I3C0

Firewall target for I3C instance 0.

SOCFPGA_NOC_FW_I3C1

Firewall target for I3C instance 1.

SOCFPGA_NOC_FW_UART0

Firewall target for UART instance 0.

SOCFPGA_NOC_FW_UART1

Firewall target for UART instance 1.

SOCFPGA_NOC_FW_DMA0

Firewall target for DMA controller 0.

SOCFPGA_NOC_FW_DMA1

Firewall target for DMA controller 1.

SOCFPGA_NOC_FW_SOC2FPGA

Firewall target for the primary HPS-to-FPGA bridge.

SOCFPGA_NOC_FW_LWSOC2FPGA

Firewall target for the Lightweight HPS-to-FPGA bridge.

SOCFPGA_NOC_FW_L4_NOC_PROBES

Firewall target for the interconnect diagnostic probes.

SOCFPGA_NOC_FW_TCU

Firewall target for the Translation Control Unit.

socfpga_noc_firewall_get
int32_t socfpga_noc_firewall_get(
uint32_t 
base_address,
socfpga_noc_firewall_target_t 
target,
uint32_t 
*
value
)

Reads the current ARM TrustZone security policy configured for a specific peripheral firewall target.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The base MMIO address of the target NoC Firewall block.

target
socfpga_noc_firewall_target_t

The specific peripheral firewall register to query.

value
uint32_t*

Pointer to store the 32-bit policy value (e.g., indicating whether Secure, Non-Secure, or both accesses are permitted).

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if the target is invalid or the pointer is NULL.

socfpga_noc_firewall_set
int32_t socfpga_noc_firewall_set(
uint32_t 
base_address,
socfpga_noc_firewall_target_t 
target,
uint32_t 
value
)

Enforces a new ARM TrustZone security policy for a specific peripheral firewall target. This dictates how the interconnect responds to transactions based on their AxPROT (protection) bus signals.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The base MMIO address of the target NoC Firewall block.

target
socfpga_noc_firewall_target_t

The specific peripheral firewall register to configure.

value
uint32_t

The 32-bit policy payload to write to the register.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if the target is invalid.

socfpga_noc_firewall_read_reg
int32_t socfpga_noc_firewall_read_reg(
uint32_t 
base_address,
uint32_t 
offset,
uint32_t 
*
value
)

Performs a direct, absolute offset read within the NoC Firewall MMIO space.  This is primarily intended for driver diagnostics or reading interconnect status registers not explicitly mapped by the target enum.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The base MMIO address of the target NoC Firewall block.

offset
uint32_t

The exact 32-bit aligned register offset to read.

value
uint32_t*

Pointer to store the resulting 32-bit hardware value.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if the pointer is NULL.

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The base MMIO address of the target NoC Firewall block.

offset
uint32_t

The exact 32-bit aligned register offset to write.

value

Returns

socfpga_noc_firewall_allow_nonsecure
int32_t socfpga_noc_firewall_allow_nonsecure(
uint32_t 
base_address,
socfpga_noc_firewall_target_t 
target
)

A specialized macro-level helper that configures the target firewall to allow Non-Secure bus transactions. By default, peripherals boot in Secure-Only mode.  This function clears the secure-access restrictions, effectively handing ownership of the peripheral over to Non-Secure operating systems (like U-Boot or Linux operating in EL1/EL2).

Parameters
base_address
uint32_t

The base MMIO address of the target NoC Firewall block.

target
socfpga_noc_firewall_target_t

The specific peripheral firewall to unlock.

Returns

0 on success; -EINVAL if the target is invalid.
